editorialSummary.heading: Early-release times, school breaks and graduations
paragraphs: Calhoun County has eight early-release days. Six have a published 1:00 p.m. dismissal time: September 30, October 30 and December 18, 2026; February 12, April 23 and May 28, 2027. Students also leave early on November 11 and March 19, but the district calendar doesn't specify a time for those two days. Check with your school before planning pickup. All times are Central Time.

Thanksgiving break runs November 23–27, 2026. Christmas break for students follows from December 21 through January 5, with classes resuming Wednesday, January 6. January 4–5 are teacher workdays, so students do not return on those dates. Spring break is March 22–26, 2027, with classes scheduled to resume March 29.

The district closed schools on October 9, 2026, because of severe weather concerns. With the October 12–13 fall holidays already scheduled, students were off October 9–13 and returned Wednesday, October 14. The original calendar still marks October 9 as the end of the first grading period. The October 7 closure notice did not announce a make-up day or a revised grading deadline.

Graduation dates vary by school. Blountstown High School graduation is May 20, followed by Altha Public School on May 21. Kindergarten ceremonies are scheduled for Altha on May 25 at 9:00 a.m., Blountstown Elementary on May 26 at 9:00 a.m., and Carr on May 27 at 8:30 a.m. Carr's eighth-grade ceremony follows at 9:15 a.m. the same day. These are school-specific events, and the district's last student day remains May 28. Ceremony times are Central Time.

about.dataSource: The supplied one-page district PDF is byte-for-byte identical to the current official download. The district Calendars page states Board Approved March 10, 2026 and supplements the PDF with kindergarten and Carr eighth-grade ceremony dates. The October 7 district weather notice supplies the October 9 closure and October 14 return.
about.processing: The complete PDF was extracted and visually inspected. October 13 is represented once as a student fall holiday, with the teacher workday explained in the note. January 4-5 staff workdays are already covered by the official December 21-January 5 student break and do not create duplicate no-school events. The October 9 weather closure and still-published first grading-period endpoint share one canonical occurrence; the closure notice controls attendance. The notice does not announce a replacement grading deadline or make-up date. There are 207 weekdays from August 13 to May 28, with 27 student-free weekdays in the original PDF and one additional verified weather closure. The calculated current attendance figure is therefore 179, not a printed official total. Eight early releases include six explicit 1:00 p.m. dates; no clock time is inferred for Veterans Day or March 19. School-specific ceremonies use a non-attendance milestone status and do not close classes for other students. FTE surveys, pre-school planning, June 1 teacher work and regular-year-unrelated summer events are omitted.
about.updates: Checked the current district calendar page, matching PDF, homepage, the full October 7 closure notice and searches for later calendar or make-up changes on October 15, 2026. The annual PDF has not been rewritten to include the operational closure; no subsequent make-up date or changed grading deadline was verified. The web calendar also adds summer-school endpoints without daily participation details.
about.disclaimer: The reviewed attendance count may change if the district announces make-up arrangements. Use school notices for the two unspecified early-release times, ceremony instructions and summer-school participation. Calendar approval is supported by the web page, not by an approval date printed in the PDF.

faqs.question: When is the first day of school in Calhoun County, FL, in 2026?
faqs.answer: Students start school Thursday, August 13, 2026. The August 3–12 pre-school planning period is for staff, not students.

faqs.question: When is the last day of school in Calhoun County, FL, in 2027?
faqs.answer: The last student day is Friday, May 28, 2027. Students are dismissed at 1:00 p.m. Central Time.

faqs.question: When is fall break for Calhoun County Schools in 2026?
faqs.answer: The scheduled fall holidays are October 12–13, 2026. Schools were also closed Friday, October 9 because of weather, giving students five consecutive days off including the weekend. Classes resumed Wednesday, October 14.

faqs.question: Do Calhoun County students have school on October 13, 2026?
faqs.answer: No. October 13 is a student holiday and a teacher professional-development/work day. Students returned Wednesday, October 14 after fall break.

faqs.question: Were Calhoun County schools closed on October 9, 2026?
faqs.answer: Yes. The district closed all school sites on Friday, October 9 because of forecast severe weather. Its October 7 announcement set Wednesday, October 14 as the return for students after the scheduled fall holidays.

faqs.question: Was a make-up day scheduled for the October 9 weather closure?
faqs.answer: The October 7 closure notice did not announce a make-up day. The district calendar and notices reviewed did not identify a replacement date. Check current district or ParentSquare announcements before relying on the earlier schedule.

faqs.question: When is Thanksgiving break in 2026?
faqs.answer: Thanksgiving holidays run Monday, November 23 through Friday, November 27, 2026. Students are scheduled to return Monday, November 30.

faqs.question: When is Christmas break for Calhoun County Schools in 2026–2027?
faqs.answer: Christmas break for students runs December 21, 2026 through January 5, 2027. The last school day before break is December 18, with 1:00 p.m. early dismissal. Classes resume January 6.

faqs.question: Do Calhoun County students return to school January 4 or January 6, 2027?
faqs.answer: Students return Wednesday, January 6. January 4 and 5 are teacher workdays and remain part of the student Christmas break.

faqs.question: When is spring break in Calhoun County schools in 2027?
faqs.answer: Spring break runs Monday, March 22 through Friday, March 26, 2027. Classes are scheduled to resume Monday, March 29.

faqs.question: Is March 19, 2027 a school day in Calhoun County?
faqs.answer: Yes. Friday, March 19 is an early-release school day before spring break, not a full day off. The district calendar does not specify a dismissal time for that date.

faqs.question: When are the early-release days for Calhoun County Schools in 2026–2027?
faqs.answer: They are September 30, October 30, November 11 and December 18, 2026, plus February 12, March 19, April 23 and May 28, 2027. All eight are student attendance days.

faqs.question: What time do students leave on early-release days?
faqs.answer: The district publishes 1:00 p.m. Central Time dismissal for September 30, October 30 and December 18, 2026, and February 12, April 23 and May 28, 2027. It does not publish a dismissal time for November 11 or March 19; check your school's instructions for those days.

faqs.question: Do students have school on Veterans Day, November 11, 2026?
faqs.answer: Yes. November 11 is listed as Veterans Day Early Release, not a full-day holiday. The district PDF does not give a dismissal time for that date.

faqs.question: Is October 30, 2026 a day off for Halloween?
faqs.answer: No. Friday, October 30 is an early-release school day, with students dismissed at 1:00 p.m. Central Time. Although the printable PDF labels it with Halloween, it is not a no-school day.

faqs.question: Which holidays give Calhoun County students a three-day weekend?
faqs.answer: Labor Day (September 7, 2026), Martin Luther King Jr. Day (January 18, 2027) and Presidents Day (February 15, 2027) are Monday student holidays. Classes are scheduled to resume the following Tuesday in each case.

faqs.question: When do the grading periods and first semester end?
faqs.answer: The annual PDF lists October 9, 2026 as the first grading-period end, December 18 as the second grading-period and first-semester end, and March 12, 2027 as the third grading-period end. Schools later closed October 9 for weather, and the reviewed notices do not give a revised grading deadline. December 18 is an early-release day.

faqs.question: When are report card days in 2026–2027?
faqs.answer: The district calendar lists Report Card Day on October 28, 2026, January 13, 2027 and March 31, 2027. It does not list a final fourth-quarter report-card date or interim-report dates.

faqs.question: When is Altha Public School graduation in 2027?

faqs.question: When is Blountstown Elementary kindergarten graduation in 2027?

faqs.question: When is Carr eighth-grade graduation in 2027?

faqs.question: Are Calhoun County schools closed on graduation days?
faqs.answer: No districtwide student holiday is listed for the May graduation ceremonies. The published last student day remains May 28, 2027. Students participating in graduation should follow their school's attendance and rehearsal instructions.

faqs.question: How many student attendance days are in the 2026–2027 calendar?
faqs.answer: The dates in the original district PDF add up to 180 student attendance weekdays. Counting the October 9 weather closure reduces that calculated figure to 179, unless a later make-up change is made. This is an independent calculation, not an official district-published attendance total.

faqs.question: When does Calhoun County summer school run in 2027?
faqs.answer: The district's calendar lists summer school beginning June 2 and ending June 30, 2027. This is separate from the regular school year ending May 28. The calendar does not specify every meeting day, daily hours or which students must attend.

faqs.question: Does this calendar cover Altha, Blountstown and Carr schools?
faqs.answer: It covers the districtwide student calendar for Calhoun County, Florida, including Altha Public School, Blountstown Elementary School, Blountstown High School and Carr Elementary & Middle School. Individual schools may publish additional event details or instructions.

faqs.question: Does Calhoun County, Florida use Central or Eastern Time?
faqs.answer: Calhoun County is in the Central Time Zone. The 1:00 p.m. early-release dismissals and published graduation ceremony times on this page are local Central Time.

faqs.question: Where can I download the official 2026–2027 school calendar?
faqs.answer: The Calhoun County School District Calendars page links its printable one-page PDF. The page identifies the calendar as approved by the School Board on March 10, 2026. The October 9 weather closure was announced separately after the PDF was published.

faqs.question: Where does Calhoun County Schools announce weather-related schedule changes?
faqs.answer: The district's October 7 closure notice says additional announcements may be shared through ParentSquare, district social media and news outlets. Check current district and school notices for changes that may not appear in the original PDF.

faqs.question: Is February 12, 2027 a school holiday in Calhoun County?
faqs.answer: No. Friday, February 12 is an early-release day, with students dismissed at 1:00 p.m. Central Time. Monday, February 15 is the Presidents Day holiday, when students have no classes.

faqs.question: Is April 23, 2027 a day off for Calhoun County students?
faqs.answer: No. Friday, April 23 is an early-release and professional-learning day. Students attend school and are dismissed at 1:00 p.m. Central Time.
